title: I Upgraded Rooks to BEAT Stockfish
summary: Tony's two rooks are replaced by Dragon Rooks (rook + knight compound) against Fairy-Stockfish. He has castling disabled for himself (enabled for Stockfish). Plan: trade into an endgame of dragon rooks vs normal rooks. Stockfish gambits, out-plays him in the middle, and wins (Rxc2 tactic, ~11:02).
rules: Player's rooks are Dragon Rooks: move like a rook OR a knight (chancellor).
Player cannot castle (dragon rooks); Stockfish can castle.
win_condition: Checkmate Fairy-Stockfish (Tony lost in the video).
